recipes.startdescription: Should I dedicate myself to my purpose? Or focus my efforts elsewhere?
recipes.description: I have decided to remain as I am... for now.

recipes.label: Blood's Dedication
recipes.startdescription: I will dedicate myself to the pursuit of sensation.
recipes.description: Some words are best heard. Some words are best tasted. That taste is on my tongue now, and I will never forget it. [I have advanced a step towards a terrible ascension.]

recipes.label: Winter's Solitude
recipes.startdescription: I will dedicate myself to the path of silence and reflection.
recipes.description: Some wisdoms are best found in the hush of a winter's night, under the blanket of a serene snowfall. That tranquillity is within me now, and I will never shatter it. [I have advanced a step towards a tranquil ascension.]

recipes.label: Histories' Narration
recipes.startdescription: I will dedicate myself to the unraveling of ancient narratives.
recipes.description: Some stories are best told in the hushed whispers of the past, inscribed in the annals of forgotten epochs. That knowledge is in my soul now, and I will never let it fade. [I have advanced a step towards an historical ascension.]

recipes.label: Lantern's Illumination
recipes.startdescription: I will dedicate myself to the path of enlightenment.
recipes.description: Some truths are best illuminated, burning away shadows of ignorance. That light is in my eyes now, and I will never blink. [I have advanced a step towards a radiant ascension.]

recipes.startdescription: I will dedicate myself to the path of opening and awakening.
recipes.description: Some doors are best opened, not by force, but by a simple knock. That knock resounds within me now, and I will never silence it. [I have advanced a step towards an awakening ascension.]

recipes.startdescription: I will dedicate myself to the path of creation and transformation.

recipes.description: Some secrets are best discovered in the moonlight, whispered on nocturnal breezes. That whisper is in my ears now, and I will never forget it. [I have advanced a step towards a mysterious ascension.]
